values: How to complete the transaction intake
Create one row for each transaction. Do not combine multiple sales into one row.
Use your own unique transaction reference. It helps identify updates or corrections later.
Choose “New listing” if Productive does not already have the property. Choose “Link existing listing” and supply the exact listing reference if it does.
Complete the yellow required fields. Add emails and mobiles where available to help match or create buyer and seller records.
Review red flagged blanks, save as an .xlsx file, and send it for import. Keep the header row unchanged.
Creates a new listing or links the transaction to an existing listing.
Records the people connected to the transaction and enough contact detail to find duplicates.
Captures the responsible agency, listing agent, and commercial details.
Captures the conveyancing contact and whether the buyer is a bond client.
Shows where the deal is in the sales and transfer process.
